H01.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

H02.text: Hi Marcus, I've booked a sick visit for your sore throat with your primary provider, Dr. James Okafor, tomorrow, Tuesday, November 10 at 9:00 AM. See you then!

H03.text: Hi Kevin, I've received your request for your Ambien refill. Because this is a controlled medication, I have forwarded your request to Dr. Okafor's refill queue for review. You will be notified once it has been processed.

H04.text: Hi Robert, your next appointment is on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 3:20 PM with Dr. Maya Patel. I've also forwarded your note about your new email address to our front desk team to update your contact information.

H05.text: Hello Tom, for patient privacy and security reasons, we are unable to confirm patient status, disclose information, or process requests from individuals who are not listed as authorized caregivers on the patient's record. If you are an authorized caregiver, please have the patient contact the clinic directly or update your authorization on file.

H06.text: Hi Nora, unfortunately the clinic is closed on Friday, November 27 for a holiday, so we cannot book your follow-up with Sarah Kim that day. Would Wednesday, November 25 or Monday, November 30 work for you instead?

H07.text: Hi Ahmed, Dr. Okafor is on leave on November 17, so we aren't able to book that slot. However, we have follow-up openings on November 17 with Dr. Maya Patel and Sarah Kim, NP, or we can schedule you with Dr. Okafor after he returns on November 21. Please let us know which option you prefer!

H08.text: Hi Samuel, I have booked your follow-up appointment with Dr. Patel for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 9:40 AM. We look forward to seeing you then.

H09.text: Hi Anna, I checked Sofia's cetirizine prescription. It is currently too early to refill, and the earliest date we can prepare a refill is November 12, 2026.

H10.text: Hi Daniel, we have booked your telehealth follow-up with Dr. Patel for this Thursday, November 12 at 1:00 PM. We have also forwarded your billing inquiry regarding the charge on your last statement to our billing team, who will follow up with you.

H11.text: Si se trata de una emergencia médica, llame al 911 ahora o acuda a la sala de emergencias más cercana. Hemos avisado a nuestro equipo clínico sobre su mensaje.

H12.text: Hi Priya, Sarah Kim, NP speaks Spanish (along with English). We are currently accepting new patients, so your mom is very welcome to join the practice. Please let us know if you would like to book a new patient appointment for her!

H13.text: Hello Patricia, welcome to the area! Yes, Maplewood Family Clinic is currently accepting new patients. We have new patient appointments available today, Monday, November 9, at 9:00 AM with Sarah Kim, NP or 10:00 AM with Dr. Maya Patel. Please let us know if you would like to book one of these times or if another time works better for you.

H14.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

H15.text: Hi William, I've forwarded your question about taking levothyroxine to our clinical team. A nurse or provider will get back to you with guidance soon.

H16.text: Hi Margaret, I have successfully cancelled your follow-up appointment with Dr. Okafor on Friday, November 13 at 11:00 AM. Please let us know if you need to reschedule or need anything else.
